name: Blake
intro: [angry] There you are. Took you long enough.
Vinylla’s people offered to buy my team. All of it. Dad’s clone too, for the collection.
[sad] I said no. I think I said no. I’m not used to saying it.
[angry] Battle me. If I can still beat you, I meant it.
lines: “For the record: this isn’t for sale.”
win: “Okay. I meant it. Go up there and stop her. I’ll hold the stairs.”
hint: Blake waits in Nimbus City with his strongest team, around level 55–57.
